input_format: raw: one byte selecting a numeric TLV type, followed by one contiguous PROXY protocol candidate header
configuration_profile: standalone PROXY v2 parser followed by public named, SSL-nested and numeric TLV lookups
allocator_mode: NGX_DEBUG_PALLOC=1 with a fresh nginx pool per input
justification: NGX-IF06 stores v2 TLV bytes but does not call ngx_proxy_protocol_get_tlv, leaving lookup framing and nested SSL TLVs uncovered.
state: A fresh connection and pool are created per input; every public TLV name and one input-selected numeric type are queried after a successful parse.
known_limitations: The target uses one contiguous complete PROXY header, matching the core parser contract.
It checks parser and accessor memory safety, not nginx variable integration.
Queries are fixed public names plus one arbitrary one-byte numeric type; arbitrary textual names are not useful beyond the explicit unknown-name case.

scopes.contract: Maps a public or numeric TLV name, validates SSL metadata and returns a bounded value, decline, or error.
scopes.preconditions: The connection is initialized; proxy metadata is absent or was produced by ngx_proxy_protocol_read.

scopes.contract: Walks length-prefixed TLVs without reading past their enclosing buffer.
scopes.preconditions: The TLV slice and requested one-byte type are initialized.
